content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent, you're eligible to begin. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals in Macon's growing logistics and manufacturing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format delivers all required project management education in a structured, hands-on environment. You'll engage directly with experienced instructors and peers, building the foundational knowledge PMI expects before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process to ensure all documentation meets PMI standards. This step formally registers you as a CAPM candidate with the Project Management Institute.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides focused exam-preparation support to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. Once you're ready, you'll sit for the proctored CAPM exam. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions and build your confidence before exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units through continuing education, volunteering, or professional activities. Staying current keeps your CAPM active and signals to Macon employers that you remain engaged in project management best practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
